sources.entry: Muster - Menu bar app that monitors Claude Code, Codex and Cursor sessions, answers Claude Code and Codex permission prompts from alerts, and switches sessions with Option-Tab.

summary.one_liner: Muster is a free, open-source macOS menu bar app that monitors Claude Code, Codex and Cursor sessions, lets you answer their permission prompts from an alert, and switches between sessions with Option-Tab.
summary.what_it_does: Muster sits in the menu bar and shows a glass alert when a coding agent is waiting on you, and the alert stays until answered. You can allow or deny Claude Code and Codex permission requests, or pick answers to Claude Code multiple-choice questions and plan approvals, without switching apps; Cursor prompts open in Cursor. Option-Down unfolds the agent's reason, full command, or answer options. Option-Tab switches sessions, most urgent first, and Control-Option-Space searches the last three hours of sessions with token and API-rate cost estimates. It reads the session files each app already writes (Claude transcripts, Codex SQLite and rollout logs, Cursor chat lists and transcripts) read-only. An optional, in-development remote mode monitors enabled SSH hosts and can install opt-in remote approval hooks.
use_cases: monitor multiple Claude Code sessions from the menu bar
approve or deny agent permission prompts without switching windows
switch quickly between running coding agent sessions
search past Claude Code, Codex and Cursor sessions
track token usage and API cost of agent sessions
monitor coding agents running on remote hosts over SSH
notable: Answers Claude Code and Codex permission prompts from the alert using Option-Return and Option-Backspace, without moving focus to the agent's app
Installs one hook per agent in the agent's own settings, keeps .muster-original and .muster-backup copies, and removes only its own hook when turned off
Optional SSH monitoring reads session summaries from enabled hosts in memory and uses no TCP listener for remote approvals
Coexists with Agent Relay by sharing one hook per agent and withdrawing the other copy after the first answer
caveats: Requires macOS 14 or later; Liquid Glass styling needs macOS 26
Remote sessions are marked 1.4, in development, and need Python 3 and noninteractive SSH access on each host
Codex approvals require enabling and trusting the Muster hook manually in Codex Settings; Cursor cannot be answered directly, only opened
Cost figures are estimates from public list prices; Codex figures are a floor and Cursor records no token counts
